transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess they brought me in because of what's been happening at work. I work at a warehouse, and... well, I keep doing things like freezing with my arms up by the forklift. I'll just stand there and copy the beeping sounds it makes, or the hand signals the guys use. 

I also keep moving the boxes in these strange little patterns. I just keep doing it, even when everyone is yelling for me to stop. So, yeah, that's why I'm here.
When you freeze with your arms up or copy the beeping sounds, can you stop yourself from doing it, or does it just happen automatically without you being able to control it?

I'm not really sure. I don't think I... I don't really try to stop it when it's happening. It just sort of happens on its own, I guess. I don't really realize I'm doing it until the guys start yelling at me to snap out of it. So, I don't know if I could stop it if I actually tried.
How long have you been doing these things — copying sounds and movements, and moving boxes in these patterns? Did this start when you were a kid, or is this something newer that began more recently?

It's newer. It definitely didn't start when I was a kid. I'd say... well, all this strange behavior at the warehouse, and I guess people have been saying my talking is confusing lately, too... it's been happening for about six months now.
How did you do in school? Were you able to keep up with your classmates, or did you have any trouble learning or understanding things compared to other kids?

I did fine in school. I mean, I never really had any trouble keeping up with the other kids or anything like that. I even went to college for a little bit after high school. So, no, learning wasn't a problem for me.
Before these behaviors started six months ago, did you have any head injuries, serious illnesses, high fevers, or did you start taking any new medications or drugs around that time?

No, nothing like that. I haven't had any head injuries or... or been sick with a fever or anything. I don't take any medications, and I haven't taken any drugs. Everything was just completely normal before all this started happening.

Before you freeze or copy those sounds and movements, do you feel like there's a buildup of tension or an urge inside you that needs to be released, or does it just happen completely out of the blue with no warning?

I don't really feel any kind of buildup or... or tension like that. It's not like an urge I have to get out. It just sort of... happens. Completely out of the blue, really. There's no warning before I do it.

When you're copying those beeping sounds or moving your arms in those patterns, are you aware of what you're doing while it's happening, or do you only realize it afterward when people tell you to stop?

I'm not really sure. It's... hard to say. I don't think I really notice it while it's happening. Usually, someone just tells me to stop, or they look at me kind of funny, and that's when I realize I was doing it. I don't really remember being aware of it right in the middle of it.

Have you had any recent infections, like the flu or a respiratory illness, even if it seemed mild? Or have you noticed any fevers, headaches, confusion, or other physical symptoms around the time these behaviors started?

No, I haven't been sick with the flu or anything like that. No fevers or headaches either. Like I said, physically, everything was just fine when all this started. I didn't notice anything wrong with my body.
In the month or two before these behaviors started, did you have a sore throat, strep throat, or any kind of throat infection that you know of?
No, I don't think so. I haven't had a sore throat or anything like strep. My throat's been fine. Like I said, I haven't been sick at all lately.
Have you had any blood tests or throat cultures done recently, or has anyone checked you for strep antibodies or a strep infection in the past few months?
No, I haven't had any blood drawn or... or throat swabs or anything like that. Since I haven't been sick, nobody's had a reason to check me for strep or run any of those tests.
In the past six to twelve months, have you noticed any rash on your body, or have your joints ever felt swollen or painful, even if it seemed minor?
No, no rashes. And my joints have been fine. I do physical work, so I get sore sometimes, but not like swollen or painful joints like you're talking about. Just regular tired from work.
Have you ever had scarlet fever, or has a doctor ever told you that you had acute rheumatic fever?
No, I haven't. I mean, I've never had scarlet fever... and no doctor has ever said anything about rheumatic fever to me.
Have you had any ear infections in the past six to twelve months, even if they seemed minor or you didn't see a doctor about them?
No, I haven't. My ears have been completely fine... I haven't had any earaches or infections or anything like that in the last year.
When these behaviors started six months ago, did it happen suddenly over a day or two, or did it develop gradually over weeks?
I'm not really sure, honestly. I don't think it was just overnight, but... I don't know exactly when it all started. It's hard to keep track of time like that.
Around the time these behaviors started six months ago, did anything major happen in your life — like a stressful event at work, problems in a relationship, or something else that was bothering you?

No, not really. I mean... work is just work, you know? Just moving stuff around. It wasn't any more stressful than usual. And I didn't have a breakup or any big fight with anyone or anything like that. Everything was pretty much just normal.

Have you had any illnesses in the past year where you felt sick but didn't go to a doctor — like maybe feeling tired, achy, or just generally unwell for a few days, even if you didn't think it was serious?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I mean, I get tired from work, moving boxes and freight around all day, but... not sick tired. I haven't had a fever or felt unwell or anything like that in the last year.
